overview.text: The RFP invites proposals for Interior Furnishing, Electrical, Data Cabling & AC Works for a new Model Branch at TILHARI JABALPUR by Punjab & Sind Bank.
Bids must be prepared as sealed offers in accordance with the RFP and Key Information sheet.
The tender process is covered under the Bank's Integrity Pact (IP) policy requiring bidders to sign a non-collusion agreement.

scope.text: The Contractor must furnish wooden partition, paneling, false ceiling including miscellaneous, electrical works and modification/addition to existing provisions.
Provision and Furniture must be complete in every respect in accordance with Contract and to the satisfaction of Architects and the Bank.

requirements.text: Bidders must create a login ID & password on the website (https://psb.eproc.in) for registration.
Earnest money of Rs. 56,000/- and Technical Bid must be duly signed and superscribed with the specific project title.
All bids and supporting documentation shall be submitted in English only.
The Technical Bid must include Service Provider's Profile, Profit and Loss Account, Balance sheet, List of contracts, and performance certificates.
Bid documents must be submitted in a prescribed format; non-adherence to format or partial submission will result in rejection.

eligibility.text: Bidders must be eligible to do business in India under relevant Indian Laws.
The bidder must have executed minimum one similar work in M.P./C.G. with a value of Rs. 22.32 Lakhs, or two works of Rs. 16.74 Lakhs, or three works of Rs. 13.95 Lakhs.
Bidders must provide minimum five (5) satisfactory performance certificates, with at least one for each year.
MSE/MSME bidders are exempted from payment of Earnest Money Deposit.

important_dates.text: Bids shall be valid for a period of 03 months from the date of submission of bids.
A bid valid for a shorter period shall be rejected by the Bank as non-responsive.

commercial_requirements.text: The Price quoted should be only in Indian Rupees.

The rates quoted in the Bid shall be inclusive of all labour charges, delivery & cost of material at site tools & equipment, insurance premium covering any risk to labour etc. and taxes and all other taxes applicable.
No claim for rate enhancement/price revision should be considered during the pendency of the contract.
Earnest money deposit of Rs. 56,000.00/- (EMD) (Refundable) should be deposited.
MSE/MSME bidders are exempted from payment of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD).
The Bidder shall bear all the costs associated with the preparation and submission of bid.

project_duration.text: Mobilization Period: 7 days from the date of Work Order.
Completion Period: 30 days from date of commencement.

important_conditions.text: The tender shall be covered under the Integrity Pact (IP) policy of the Bank. Any vendor/bidder not signed the document or refusing to sign shall be disqualified in the bidding process.
Earnest money would be released to the unsuccessful bidders after signing of the contract agreement by the L1 bidder.
In the event of non-submission of earnest money deposit, the proposal would be rejected.
Earnest Money Deposit is refundable.

overview.text: The contractor must suspend work on written order from the Architect/Bank and protect/secure the work during suspension at their own expense.
